notes: Each channel has its own buttons: Ideas, its films, Settings (or Finish setup), and the bin.
Settings opens the whole New Vessel menu again: looks, Absorb, Describe, Learn from a film. It warns you once the channel has made films.
Pasting a link inside a channel's settings fills that channel; it no longer makes a second one.
The Mojo Bag shows each service's real 7-day spend and High Juju's plan as a percentage with its reset; Read again reads everything.
Gris-gris says what it is: the everyday mix.
